Responses API

    POST
    
/responses
model string

Possible values: [deepseek-v4-flash, deepseek-v4-pro, deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp]

tools

Possible values: [function, web_search, web_search_2025_08_26]. Web search is executed on the server side.

usage

input_tokens, input_tokens_details.cached_tokens, output_tokens, output_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens, and total_tokens.
